verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶל־ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְהַטֵּ֖ף אֶל־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֑ים וְהִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־ אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām śîm pā·ne·ḵā ’el- yə·rū·šā·lim wə·haṭ·ṭêp̄ ’el- miq·dā·šîm wə·hin·nā·ḇê ’el- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Son of man set your face against Jerusalem and preach against the sanctuaries Prophesy against the land of Israel
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, olha para Jerusalém, e deixa cair a tua palavra para os santuários, e profetiza contra a terra de Israel.

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ לְאַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֣י אֵלַ֔יִךְ וְהוֹצֵאתִ֥י חַרְבִּ֖י מִתַּעְרָ֑הּ וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֵּ֖ךְ צַדִּ֥יק וְרָשָֽׁע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā lə·’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî ’ê·la·yiḵ wə·hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ḥar·bî mit·ta‘·rāh wə·hiḵ·rat·tî mim·mêḵ ṣad·dîq wə·rā·šā‘
verses.literal: and tell . . . her that this is what the LORD . . . says I am against you and I will draw My sword from its sheath and cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked
verses.literalPt: Dize à terra de Israel: Assim diz Jeová: Eis que sou contra ti, e tirarei a minha espada da sua bainha, e exterminarei do meio de ti o justo e o ímpio.

verses.original: יַ֛עַן אֲשֶׁר־ הִכְרַ֥תִּי מִמֵּ֖ךְ צַדִּ֣יק וְרָשָׁ֑ע לָ֠כֵן תֵּצֵ֨א חַרְבִּ֧י מִתַּעְרָ֛הּ אֶל־ כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֖ר מִנֶּ֥גֶב צָפֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ’ă·šer- hiḵ·rat·tî mim·mêḵ ṣad·dîq wə·rā·šā‘ lā·ḵên tê·ṣê ḥar·bî mit·ta‘·rāh ’el- kāl- bā·śār min·ne·ḡeḇ ṣā·p̄ō·wn
verses.literal: Because I will cut off both the righteous and the wicked My sword will be unsheathed against everyone . . . from south to north
verses.literalPt: Visto, pois, que exterminarei do meio de ti o justo e o ímpio, por isso a minha espada sairá da sua bainha contra toda carne, desde o Sul até o Norte;

verses.original: וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֔ר כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה הוֹצֵ֥אתִי חַרְבִּ֖י מִתַּעְרָ֑הּ לֹ֥א תָשׁ֖וּב עֽוֹד׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kāl- bā·śār kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ḥar·bî mit·ta‘·rāh lō ṯā·šūḇ ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Then all flesh will know that I the LORD have taken My sword from its sheath not to return it again
verses.literalPt: e saberá toda a carne que eu, Jeová, tirei da bainha a minha espada; para lá não se tornará mais.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֥ה בֶן־ אָדָ֖ם הֵֽאָנַ֑ח בְּשִׁבְר֤וֹן מָתְנַ֙יִם֙ וּבִמְרִיר֔וּת תֵּֽאָנַ֖ח לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hê·’ā·naḥ bə·šiḇ·rō·wn mā·ṯə·na·yim ū·ḇim·rî·rūṯ tê·’ā·naḥ lə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: But you son of man groan Groan before their eyes with a broken heart and bitter grief
verses.literalPt: Suspira, pois, filho do homem; aos olhos deles, com quebrantamento dos lombos e com amargura, darás suspiros.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כִּֽי־ יֹאמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ עַל־ מָ֖ה אַתָּ֣ה נֶאֱנָ֑ח וְאָמַרְתָּ֡ אֶל־ שְׁמוּעָ֣ה כִֽי־ בָאָ֡ה וְנָמֵ֣ס כָּל־ לֵב֩ וְרָפ֨וּ כָל־ יָדַ֜יִם וְכִהֲתָ֣ה כָל־ ר֗וּחַ וְכָל־ בִּרְכַּ֙יִם֙ תֵּלַ֣כְנָה מַּ֔יִם הִנֵּ֤ה בָאָה֙ וְנִֽהְיָ֔תָה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- yō·mə·rū ’ê·le·ḵā ‘al- māh ’at·tāh ne·’ĕ·nāḥ wə·’ā·mar·tā ’el- šə·mū·‘āh ḵî- ḇā·’āh wə·nā·mês kāl- lêḇ wə·rā·p̄ū ḵāl yā·ḏa·yim wə·ḵi·hă·ṯāh ḵāl rū·aḥ wə·ḵāl bir·ka·yim tê·laḵ·nāh ma·yim hin·nêh ḇā·’āh wə·nih·yā·ṯāh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: And when they ask Why . . . are you groaning you are to say Because of the news that is coming Every heart will melt and every hand will go limp Every spirit will faint and every knee will turn to water Yes it is coming and it will surely happen declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Quando te disserem: Por que suspiras tu? Dirás: Por causa das novas, porque elas vêm. Todos os corações se derreterão, todas as mãos se enfraquecerão, e todos os joelhos ficarão fracos como água; eis que elas vêm e se cumprirão, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הִנָּבֵא֙ וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֑י אֱמֹ֕ר חֶ֥רֶב חֶ֛רֶב הוּחַ֖דָּה וְגַם־ מְרוּטָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām hin·nā·ḇê wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ĕ·mōr ḥe·reḇ ḥe·reḇ hū·ḥad·dāh wə·ḡam- mə·rū·ṭāh
verses.literal: Son of man prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord . . . says A sword a sword sharpened and polished
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, profetiza e dize: Assim diz o Senhor: A espada, a espada, está afiada e polida;

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן טְבֹ֤חַ טֶ֙בַח֙ הוּחַ֔דָּה לְמַעַן־ הֱיֵה־ לָ֥הּ בָּ֖רָק מֹרָ֑טָּה א֣וֹ נָשִׂ֔ישׂ שֵׁ֥בֶט בְּנִ֖י מֹאֶ֥סֶת כָּל־ עֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an ṭə·ḇō·aḥ ṭe·ḇaḥ hū·ḥad·dāh lə·ma·‘an- hĕ·yêh- lāh bā·rāq mō·rāṭ·ṭāh ’ōw nā·śîś šê·ḇeṭ bə·nî mō·’e·seṯ kāl- ‘êṣ
verses.literal: it is sharpened . . . . . . for the slaughter . . . polished . . . to flash like lightning Should we rejoice in the scepter of My son The sword despises every such stick
verses.literalPt: está afiada para fazer uma matança; está polida para ser como relâmpago. Havemos, pois, de nos alegrar? A vara de meu filho despreza todas as árvores.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛הּ לְמָרְטָ֖ה לִתְפֹּ֣שׂ בַּכָּ֑ף הִֽיא־ הוּחַ֤דָּה חֶ֙רֶב֙ וְהִ֣יא מֹרָ֔טָּה לָתֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖הּ בְּיַד־ הוֹרֵֽג׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯāh lə·mā·rə·ṭāh liṯ·pōś bak·kāp̄ hî- hū·ḥad·dāh ḥe·reḇ wə·hî mō·rāṭ·ṭāh lā·ṯêṯ ’ō·w·ṯāh bə·yaḏ- hō·w·rêḡ
verses.literal: The sword is appointed to be polished to be grasped in the hand It is sharpened and polished to be placed in the hand of the slayer
verses.literalPt: Ela se dá a polir, para que seja manejada; esta espada está afiada, está polida, para se meter na mão de quem vai fazer a matança.

verses.original: זְעַ֤ק וְהֵילֵל֙ בֶּן־ אָדָ֔ם כִּי־ הִיא֙ הָיתָ֣ה בְעַמִּ֔י הִ֖יא בְּכָל־ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מְגוּרֵ֤י אֶל־ חֶ֙רֶב֙ הָי֣וּ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י לָכֵ֖ן סְפֹ֥ק אֶל־ יָרֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: zə·‘aq wə·hê·lêl ben- ’ā·ḏām kî- hî hå̄y·ṯå̄h ḇə·‘am·mî hî bə·ḵāl nə·śî·’ê yiś·rā·’êl mə·ḡū·rê ’el- ḥe·reḇ hā·yū ’eṯ- ‘am·mî lā·ḵên sə·p̄ōq ’el- yā·rêḵ
verses.literal: Cry out and wail O son of man for the sword is wielded against My people it is against all the princes of Israel They are tossed to the sword with My people therefore strike . . . your thigh
verses.literalPt: Grita e uiva, filho do homem, pois ela está sobre o meu povo, está sobre todos os príncipes de Israel. Estes, juntamente com o meu povo, estão entregues à espada; portanto, dá pancadas na tua coxa.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בֹ֔חַן וּמָ֕ה אִם־ גַּם־ שֵׁ֥בֶט מֹאֶ֖סֶת לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶ֑ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî ḇō·ḥan ū·māh ’im- gam- šê·ḇeṭ mō·’e·seṯ lō yih·yeh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Surely testing will come And what if even the scepter which the sword despises does not continue declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Pois há uma prova; e que será, se não mais subsistir a vara que despreza tudo? — diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֔ם הִנָּבֵ֕א וְהַ֖ךְ כַּ֣ף אֶל־ כָּ֑ף וְתִכָּפֵ֞ל חֶ֤רֶב שְׁלִישִׁ֙תָה֙ חֶ֣רֶב חֲלָלִ֔ים הִ֗יא חֶ֚רֶב חָלָ֣ל הַגָּד֔וֹל הַחֹדֶ֖רֶת לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hin·nā·ḇê wə·haḵ kap̄ ’el- kāp̄ wə·ṯik·kā·p̄êl ḥe·reḇ šə·lî·ši·ṯāh ḥe·reḇ ḥă·lā·lîm hî ḥe·reḇ ḥā·lāl hag·gā·ḏō·wl ha·ḥō·ḏe·reṯ lā·hem
verses.literal: So then son of man prophesy and strike your hands together . . . . . . Let the sword strike two times even three It is a sword that slays a sword of great slaughter closing in on every side . . .
verses.literalPt: Tu, pois, filho do homem, profetiza e bate com as mãos uma na outra; e dobre-se a espada três vezes, a espada dos mortalmente feridos. É a espada do grande que está mortalmente ferido, a que os rodeia.

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן׀ לָמ֣וּג לֵ֗ב וְהַרְבֵּה֙ הַמִּכְשֹׁלִ֔ים עַ֚ל כָּל־ שַׁ֣עֲרֵיהֶ֔ם נָתַ֖תִּי אִבְחַת־ חָ֑רֶב אָ֛ח עֲשׂוּיָ֥ה לְבָרָ֖ק מְעֻטָּ֥ה לְטָֽבַח׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an lā·mūḡ lêḇ wə·har·bêh ham·miḵ·šō·lîm ‘al kāl- ša·‘ă·rê·hem nā·ṯat·tî ’iḇ·ḥaṯ- ḥā·reḇ ’āḥ ‘ă·śū·yāh lə·ḇā·rāq mə·‘uṭ·ṭāh lə·ṭā·ḇaḥ
verses.literal: So that their hearts may melt and many may stumble I have appointed at all their gates a sword for slaughter Yes it is ready to flash like lightning it is drawn for slaughter
verses.literalPt: Pus a ponta da espada contra todas as suas portas, para que se lhes derreta o coração e se lhes multiplique o tropeçar. Ah! Ela está feita como relâmpago, está aguçada para matar.

verses.original: הִתְאַחֲדִ֥י הֵימִ֖נִי הָשִׂ֣ימִי הַשְׂמִ֑ילִי אָ֖נָה פָּנַ֥יִךְ מֻעָדֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·’a·ḥă·ḏî hê·mi·nî hā·śî·mî haś·mî·lî ’ā·nāh pā·na·yiḵ mu·‘ā·ḏō·wṯ
verses.literal: Slash to the right set your blade to the left wherever your blade is directed
verses.literalPt: Une as tuas forças, ó espada, vai-te para a direita; prepara-te, e vai-te para a esquerda, para onde quer que o teu rosto se dirigir.

verses.original: וְגַם־ אֲנִ֗י אַכֶּ֤ה כַפִּי֙ אֶל־ כַּפִּ֔י וַהֲנִחֹתִ֖י חֲמָתִ֑י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ’ă·nî ’ak·keh ḵap·pî ’el- kap·pî wa·hă·ni·ḥō·ṯî ḥă·mā·ṯî ’ă·nî Yah·weh dib·bar·tî
verses.literal: I too will strike My hands together . . . . . . and I will satisfy My wrath I the LORD have spoken
verses.literalPt: Também eu baterei as mãos uma na outra, e satisfarei o meu furor. Eu, Jeová, o disse.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: De novo, veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֨ה בֶן־ אָדָ֜ם שִׂים־ לְךָ֣׀ שְׁנַ֣יִם דְּרָכִ֗ים לָבוֹא֙ חֶ֣רֶב מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֔ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ אֶחָ֖ד יֵצְא֣וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם וְיָ֣ד בָּרֵ֔א בְּרֹ֥אשׁ דֶּֽרֶךְ־ עִ֖יר בָּרֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām śîm- lə·ḵā šə·na·yim də·rā·ḵîm lā·ḇō·w ḥe·reḇ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel mê·’e·reṣ ’e·ḥāḏ yê·ṣə·’ū šə·nê·hem wə·yāḏ bā·rê bə·rōš de·reḵ- ‘îr bā·rê
verses.literal: Now you son of man mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take both starting from the same land And make a signpost where the road branches off to each city . . .
verses.literalPt: Também tu, filho do homem, traça dois caminhos por onde venha a espada do rei de Babilônia. De uma só terra sairão ambos; marca um lugar; marca-o no princípio do caminho da cidade.

verses.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ תָּשִׂ֔ים לָב֣וֹא חֶ֔רֶב אֵ֖ת רַבַּ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ עַמּ֑וֹן וְאֶת־ יְהוּדָ֥ה בִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּצוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: de·reḵ tā·śîm lā·ḇō·w ḥe·reḇ ’êṯ rab·baṯ bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn wə·’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh ḇî·rū·šā·lim bə·ṣū·rāh
verses.literal: Mark out one road for the sword to come against Rabbah of the Ammonites . . . and another against Judah into fortified Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Faze um caminho por onde virá a espada a Rabá dos filhos de Amom, e a Judá, e a Jerusalém, a fortificada.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עָמַ֨ד מֶלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֜ל אֶל־ אֵ֣ם הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ בְּרֹ֛אשׁ שְׁנֵ֥י הַדְּרָכִ֖ים לִקְסָם־ קָ֑סֶם קִלְקַ֤ל בַּֽחִצִּים֙ שָׁאַ֣ל בַּתְּרָפִ֔ים רָאָ֖ה בַּכָּבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ā·maḏ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ’el- ’êm had·de·reḵ bə·rōš šə·nê had·də·rā·ḵîm liq·sām- qā·sem qil·qal ba·ḥiṣ·ṣîm šā·’al bat·tə·rā·p̄îm rā·’āh bak·kā·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: For the king of Babylon stands at the fork in the road at the junction of the two roads to seek an omen He shakes the arrows he consults the idols he examines the liver
verses.literalPt: Pois o rei de Babilônia para na encruzilhada, no princípio dos dois caminhos, para usar de adivinhações; sacode as setas, consulta os terafins, examina os rins.

verses.original: בִּֽימִינ֞וֹ הָיָ֣ה׀ הַקֶּ֣סֶם יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם לָשׂ֤וּם כָּרִים֙ לִפְתֹּ֤חַ פֶּה֙ בְּרֶ֔צַח לְהָרִ֥ים ק֖וֹל בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה לָשׂ֤וּם כָּרִים֙ עַל־ שְׁעָרִ֔ים לִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ סֹלְלָ֖ה לִבְנ֥וֹת דָּיֵֽק׃
verses.transliteration: bî·mî·nōw hā·yāh haq·qe·sem yə·rū·šā·lim lā·śūm kā·rîm lip̄·tō·aḥ peh bə·re·ṣaḥ lə·hā·rîm qō·wl biṯ·rū·‘āh lā·śūm kā·rîm ‘al- šə·‘ā·rîm liš·pōḵ sō·lə·lāh liḇ·nō·wṯ dā·yêq
verses.literal: In his right hand appears the portent for Jerusalem where he is to set up battering rams to call for . . . the slaughter to lift a battle cry . . . to direct the battering rams against the gates to build a ramp and to erect a siege wall
verses.literalPt: Na sua mão direita, achava-se a adivinhação sobre Jerusalém, para dispor os aríetes, para abrir a boca com ordens de matar, para levantar a voz com alarido, para pôr os aríetes contra as portas, para levantar terraplenos, para edificar fortes.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה לָהֶ֤ם כִּקְסוֹם שָׁוְא֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם שְׁבֻעֵ֥י שְׁבֻע֖וֹת לָהֶ֑ם וְהֽוּא־ מַזְכִּ֥יר עָוֺ֖ן לְהִתָּפֵֽשׂ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lā·hem kiq·sōm šāw bə·‘ê·nê·hem šə·ḇu·‘ê šə·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ lā·hem wə·hū- maz·kîr ‘ā·wōn lə·hit·tā·p̄êś
verses.literal: It will seem like a false omen to the eyes of those who have sworn allegiance to him but it will draw attention to their guilt and take them captive
verses.literalPt: E será isso como adivinhação vã aos olhos daqueles que lhes fizeram juramentos, porém ele se lembrará da iniquidade, para que sejam apanhados.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ יַ֗עַן הַזְכַּרְכֶם֙ עֲוֺ֣נְכֶ֔ם בְּהִגָּל֣וֹת פִּשְׁעֵיכֶ֗ם לְהֵֽרָאוֹת֙ חַטֹּ֣אותֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל עֲלִילֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם יַ֚עַן הִזָּ֣כֶרְכֶ֔ם בַּכַּ֖ף תִּתָּפֵֽשׂוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an haz·kar·ḵem ‘ă·wō·nə·ḵem bə·hig·gā·lō·wṯ piš·‘ê·ḵem lə·hê·rā·’ō·wṯ ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯê·ḵem bə·ḵōl ‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯê·ḵem ya·‘an hiz·zā·ḵer·ḵem bak·kap̄ tit·tā·p̄ê·śū
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Because you have drawn attention to your guilt exposing your transgressions so that your sins are revealed in all your deeds because you have come to remembrance you shall be taken in hand
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Porque fizestes que seja lembrada a vossa iniquidade, sendo descobertas as vossas transgressões, de maneira que em todos os vossos feitos aparecem os vossos pecados; porquanto sois lembrados, sereis apanhados com a mão.

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ חָלָ֣ל רָשָׁ֔ע נְשִׂ֖יא יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֣א יוֹמ֔וֹ בְּעֵ֖ת עֲוֺ֥ן קֵֽץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḥā·lāl rā·šā‘ nə·śî yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- bā yō·w·mōw bə·‘êṯ ‘ă·wōn qêṣ
verses.literal: And you O profane and wicked prince of Israel the day . . . has come for your final punishment . . .
verses.literalPt: Ó tu, ímpio mortalmente ferido, príncipe de Israel, cujo dia é chegado, no tempo em que termina a iniquidade;

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הָסִיר֙ הַמִּצְנֶ֔פֶת וְהָרִ֖ים הָֽעֲטָרָ֑ה זֹ֣את לֹא־ זֹ֔את הַשָּׁפָ֣לָה הַגְבֵּ֔הַ וְהַגָּבֹ֖הַ הַשְׁפִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hā·sîr ham·miṣ·ne·p̄eṯ wə·hā·rîm hā·‘ă·ṭā·rāh zōṯ lō- zōṯ haš·šā·p̄ā·lāh haḡ·bē·ha wə·hag·gå̄·ḇō·ha haš·pîl
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Remove the turban and take off the crown Things will not remain as they are . . . Exalt the lowly and bring low the exalted
verses.literalPt: assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Remove o diadema e tira a coroa; o que é não mais será o mesmo; exalte-se o que está abatido, e abata-se o que está exaltado.

verses.original: עַוָּ֥ה עַוָּ֖ה עַוָּ֣ה אֲשִׂימֶ֑נָּה גַּם־ זֹאת֙ לֹ֣א הָיָ֔ה עַד־ בֹּ֛א אֲשֶׁר־ ל֥וֹ הַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט וּנְתַתִּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘aw·wāh ‘aw·wāh ‘aw·wāh ’ă·śî·men·nāh gam- zōṯ lō hā·yāh ‘aḏ- bō ’ă·šer- lōw ham·miš·pāṭ ū·nə·ṯat·tîw
verses.literal: A ruin a ruin I will make it a ruin And it will not be restored until the arrival of Him to whom it belongs to whom I have assigned the right of judgment
verses.literalPt: Eu o transtornarei, transtornarei, transtornarei; também o que é não continuará, até que venha aquele a quem pertence o direito; e lho darei a ele.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֗ם הִנָּבֵ֤א וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֔ה אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן וְאֶל־ חֶרְפָּתָ֑ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ חֶ֣רֶב חֶ֤רֶב פְּתוּחָה֙ לְטֶ֣בַח מְרוּטָ֔ה לְהָכִ֖יל לְמַ֥עַן בָּרָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hin·nā·ḇê wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’el- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn wə·’el- ḥer·pā·ṯām wə·’ā·mar·tā ḥe·reḇ ḥe·reḇ pə·ṯū·ḥāh lə·ṭe·ḇaḥ mə·rū·ṭāh lə·hā·ḵîl lə·ma·‘an bā·rāq
verses.literal: Now prophesy son of man and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says concerning the Ammonites . . . . . . and their contempt A sword A sword is drawn for slaughter polished to consume to flash like lightning
verses.literalPt: Tu, filho do homem, profetiza e dize: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová acerca dos filhos de Amom e acerca do opróbrio deles; dize: A espada, a espada está desembainhada, para a matança está polida, a fim de que devore, que seja como relâmpago;

verses.original: בַּחֲז֥וֹת לָךְ֙ שָׁ֔וְא בִּקְסָם־ לָ֖ךְ כָּזָ֑ב לָתֵ֣ת אוֹתָ֗ךְ אֶֽל־ צַוְּארֵי֙ חַֽלְלֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֣א יוֹמָ֔ם בְּעֵ֖ת עֲוֺ֥ן קֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥă·zō·wṯ lāḵ šāw biq·sām- lāḵ kā·zāḇ lā·ṯêṯ ’ō·w·ṯāḵ ’el- ṣaw·wə·rê ḥal·lê rə·šā·‘îm ’ă·šer- bā yō·w·mām bə·‘êṯ ‘ă·wōn qêṣ
verses.literal: while they offer false visions for you and lying divinations about you to be placed on the necks of the wicked who are slain whose day has come the time of their final punishment . . .
verses.literalPt: no tempo em que para ti veem vaidade e adivinham mentiras, para te porem sobre os pescoços dos ímpios que estão mortalmente feridos, cujo dia é chegado, no tempo em que termina a iniquidade.

verses.original: הָשַׁ֖ב אֶל־ תַּעְרָ֑הּ בִּמְק֧וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ נִבְרֵ֛את בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מְכֻרוֹתַ֖יִךְ אֶשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·šaḇ ’el- ta‘·rāh bim·qō·wm ’ă·šer- niḇ·rêṯ bə·’e·reṣ mə·ḵu·rō·w·ṯa·yiḵ ’eš·pōṭ ’ō·ṯāḵ
verses.literal: Return the sword to its sheath In the place where you were created in the land of your origin I will judge you
verses.literalPt: Torna-a para a bainha. No lugar em que foste criado, na terra da tua natividade, eu te julgarei.

verses.original: וְשָׁפַכְתִּ֤י עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ זַעְמִ֔י בְּאֵ֥שׁ עֶבְרָתִ֖י אָפִ֣יחַ עָלָ֑יִךְ וּנְתַתִּ֗יךְ בְּיַד֙ אֲנָשִׁ֣ים בֹּֽעֲרִ֔ים חָרָשֵׁ֖י מַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·p̄aḵ·tî ‘ā·la·yiḵ za‘·mî bə·’êš ‘eḇ·rā·ṯî ’ā·p̄î·aḥ ‘ā·lā·yiḵ ū·nə·ṯat·tîḵ bə·yaḏ ’ă·nā·šîm bō·‘ă·rîm ḥā·rā·šê maš·ḥîṯ
verses.literal: I will pour out My anger upon you I will breathe the fire of My fury against you I will hand you over to . . . brutal men skilled in destruction
verses.literalPt: Derramarei sobre ti a minha indignação, assoprarei sobre ti com o fogo do meu furor e te entregarei nas mãos de homens brutais, destros para destruírem.

verses.original: לָאֵ֤שׁ תִּֽהְיֶה֙ לְאָכְלָ֔ה דָּמֵ֥ךְ יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ הָאָ֑רֶץ לֹ֣א תִזָּכֵ֔רִי כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃פ
verses.transliteration: lā·’êš tih·yeh lə·’āḵ·lāh dā·mêḵ yih·yeh bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·’ā·reṣ lō ṯiz·zā·ḵê·rî kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh dib·bar·tî
verses.literal: You will be fuel for the fire Your blood will stain your own land You will not be remembered for I the LORD have spoken
verses.literalPt: Servirás de pasto ao fogo; o teu sangue será no meio da terra; não serás mais lembrado. Pois eu, Jeová, o disse.
